head.heading: How a Fruition *implementation runs*
head.lead: The same five stages sit behind every package. Training & Optimisation compresses them; the other two run each in full.

items.body: We map team structures, current tools and the steps people actually follow, then agree the future process with the people who run it.
items.title: Discovery and process analysis

items.body: Boards, columns, views, dashboards, forms and permissions built to the agreed design, using monday.com's native features first.
items.title: Configuration and customisation

items.body: Data moved from spreadsheets or legacy tools, and integrations set up to systems such as Xero, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outlook, Slack or Jira.
items.title: Data migration and integration

items.body: Role-based training for end users, champions and admins, with documentation written for your workflows rather than generic guides.
items.title: Training and onboarding

items.body: A supported go-live, adoption checks and a clear path to a Deployed Engineer or ad-hoc help as your processes change.
items.title: Go-live and ongoing support

head.heading: Built to be adopted, *not abandoned*
head.lead: Process first, delivered in your time zone, by a team that started inside monday.com.

items.body: We map and agree the process before we build. It's why our implementations get adopted instead of abandoned after the first month.
